preheader: Your breath reset is inside, with a few words on how to use it.
page_title: Breathe with Diana, your free breath reset
hero_alt: The room where Diana holds her sessions, cushions in a circle around a small altar
page_sub: Ten quiet minutes, lying down, wherever you are. Nothing to get right.
p_thanks: Thank you for asking for this.
p_what: It is a short practice you can do lying down, wherever you are. It does not ask you to get anything right. It asks for a few quiet minutes, and for your willingness to feel what is already there.
cta_listen_note: It opens in your browser, so you can come back to it any time.
player_title: A breath to come home to
pending: The recording is being finished. As soon as it is ready it will play right here, and you will not need to do anything, this page will simply have it.
before_1: Find ten minutes where nobody needs you.
before_2: Lie down somewhere warm and comfortable.
before_3: Headphones if you have them, so my voice is close.
before_4: If it becomes too much, open your eyes and breathe normally. That is not failing, that is listening.
after_p: Afterwards you may feel lighter, or tired, or a little tender. All of it is welcome. There is nothing to do with it except let it settle.
door_p1: Some people do this practice and feel a small, quiet relief. Others notice something older underneath it, something a ten minute practice does not reach. If that is you, we can sit with it together.
door_p2: The first conversation is free and takes fifteen minutes. No plan, no pressure, just the two of us working out whether this is right for you.
alt_after: , or simply reply to this email.
